game.name: Far Cry Instincts Predator (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: In Far Cry Instincts Predator, a first-person shooter for Xbox 360, you play as the indomitable Jack Carver, a man caught up in his past while living a peaceful life on a tropical island. Hunted by a horde of elite mercenaries, your survival skills and legendary predatory instincts will be your best weapons to stay alive.
